bear.text: The CFO stated on the earnings call that receivable days increased from 78 to 96 over the last year, mainly due to slower payments from two large state utility customers.
The company disclosed that it received a GST demand order for 46.3 crore rupees, including interest and penalty, relating to input tax credit claimed for FY2020-21 and FY2021-22.

bull.text: The company reported that its order book stood at 3,900 crore rupees as of 30 June 2026, up from 3,150 crore rupees a year ago.
Exports contributed 21% of revenue in Q1 FY27, an increase from 16% in Q1 FY26.
Management maintains its revenue growth guidance of 15 to 17 percent for the full year FY27.
The company says the new Bharuch plant, which adds about 30% to cable capacity, is on track to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27.

open_questions.text: The company's press release reports Q1 FY27 revenue of 1,248 crore rupees, while a news article reports 1,428 crore rupees. What explains this discrepancy between the company's official filing and the secondary news report?

A March 2024 news article reported promoter pledge at 35%, while the June 2026 exchange filing shows pledged shares at 4.1% of promoter holding. What explains the difference between the 2024 news report and the 2026 official filing?
Management states that about two-thirds of contracts have price-variation clauses that reset with a lag of one to two quarters. How will this lag affect margins in the upcoming quarters?

snapshot.text: Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors.
For Q1 FY27, the company reported revenue of 1,248 crore rupees, EBITDA of 140 crore rupees, an EBITDA margin of 11.2%, and profit after tax of 82 crore rupees.
As of June 2026, promoters held 58.2% of the company, with 4.1% of that holding pledged.
